history.text: Mobile users at Orbit Desk get logged out every morning. Support has 60 tickets this week. Find it.

Refresh tokens rotate on every use, and the mobile app fires two refresh calls in parallel on wake. The second call presents an already-rotated token, the server treats that as token theft and revokes the whole family. That logs the user out.
So what are the options? I don't want to weaken theft detection for nothing.

Two options. A: a 30 second reuse grace window on the server, which keeps detection for anything older. B: serialize refresh in the mobile app, which needs an app store release and leaves old versions broken. I recommend A now and B later.
Go with A. Keep B as a follow-up ticket. Write the test for the parallel refresh first.
Writing the parallel refresh test first, then the grace window.
Finance at Orbit Desk needs the monthly invoice export as CSV with VAT split per country. Build it.
Building the export job now. The VAT split reads from the tax ledger. Running it against the October data next.
In the voice addon, barge-in is flaky: when I interrupt, it sometimes keeps talking for two seconds. Investigate.

The speech gate waits for the full audio chunk before it cancels playback. Chunks are 1.8 seconds at the current buffer size, which matches what you hear. I can cut the chunk to 200 ms and cancel on the first voiced frame, at a small cost in CPU.
Do that and measure the latency before and after.
Changing the buffer now and measuring interrupt-to-silence latency across 40 scripted interruptions.
